paragraphs: eGain automates customer experience with an AI knowledge hub solution. We sell our SaaS solution to enterprises who want to improve customer experience while reducing cost, by using AI to synthesize and deliver trusted, consumable answers from a knowledge hub. We are headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, USA. We also operate in the United Kingdom and India.

According to Gartner Research, a majority of contact center agents are not satisfied with their desktop tools. Our assessment, based on more than two decades of serving clients is that good contact center agents ignore most information piled on their screens across multiple windows and tabs when they are interacting with customers. They focus on the customer conversation. Meanwhile, businesses expect agents to remember and refresh growing knowhow that is needed to answer customer questions across complex, expanding product portfolios and compliance-heavy processes, and then recall it contextually in the moment of truth – when the customer is on the line. In addition, this is expected of an entry-level workforce that is not well-paid, routinely replaced, and globally dispersed – mainly for cost reasons. This knowledge and guidance gap for agents in the flow of their work explains Gartner Research's top technology recommendation for customer service and support leaders: invest in modern knowledge management tools.

In a world selling commoditized, yet complex products to time-strapped customers, smart tools must increasingly automate self-service interactions and augment agent-assisted customer experiences. In a hybrid workplace, businesses realize that they need to invest in tools that can guide agents and customers with trusted answers, ensuring compliance. Further, AI investments are struggling to deliver value at scale because of the "Garbage In Garbage Out" problem of fragmented knowledge content across an enterprise. The answer is a centralized knowledge hub, a single source of truth that is powered by AI and orchestrated by experts in the loop.

To automate customer engagement, generative AI needs trusted content from a knowledge hub that ensures correct, compliant content is served with adequate controls. A knowledge hub can be built and maintained with much less time and cost using AI. It is a perfect technology bootstrap - AI needs trusted knowledge as input and trusted knowledge can be built much easier using AI.

Contact centers offer a great opportunity within any business operation to automate using AI. According to Forrester Research, there were 17 million contact center agents worldwide in 2024, with 71% of contact centers looking to hire more. Time-starved customers consuming complex products and grappling with extreme choices generate stubbornly high levels of customer contact. They need quick, correct, and assured help. The business impact of applying AI at scale on contact center operations could be hundreds of billions of dollars saved annually on a global basis, not to mention the positive effect of good service.

Businesses continue to invest in digital transformation, especially in customer experience. To further reduce cost and improve experience, businesses want to harness AI knowledge to automate customer service via omnichannel, conversational interfaces. According to McKinsey, the aggregate cost of customer operations in the global economy is

$1.5 trillion. They anticipate that businesses could reduce this cost by 35% using AI. Given these potential savings, the associated market opportunity for AI SaaS solutions for customer experience (CX) is huge. According to a 2024 Gartner Research prediction, 100% of all virtual customer assistant and virtual agent assistant projects that are not integrated with a modern knowledge management system will fail to meet their experience improvement and operational cost-reduction goals.

We believe customer service queries fall into three categories: informational, transactional, and situational. A customer contact could span one of more of these three categories as the conversation develops. Tools must orchestrate customer contact with context — accounting for machine-human hand-offs (mixed-initiative interaction), channel switching, multimodal interaction, and conversational pause-and-resume. During these interactions, customers increasingly want guidance and trusted answers.
eGain offers a comprehensive solution organized into three hubs — eGain AI Agent™, eGain AI Knowledge Hub™, and eGain Conversation Hub™ — to automate customer experiences.

eGain AI Agent helps businesses easily deploy enterprise-grade agentic solutions built on trusted knowledge and guided actions. Our AI Agent for contact center assists human agents by actively listening to customer conversations and proactively guiding them step-by-step, across intent identification, issue resolution and contact wrap up.

eGain AI Knowledge Hub helps businesses to centralize knowledge, policies, procedures, situational expertise, and best-practices, while delivering guided, personalized, and trusted answers to customers, agents, and field staff. We believe our guided knowledge applications ensure that all human agents can handle their contacts regardless of tenure or expertise.

eGain Conversation Hub offers comprehensive, scalable capabilities for digital-first interaction management within a modern, omnichannel desktop. Human agents are proactively guided by AI knowledge to efficiently serve customers via chat, short message service (SMS), email, social media, phone, video, fax, and letter.

Our open, secure platform APIs enable clients and partners to extend and enhance our solutions and to integrate with enterprise assets to enable a single view of the customer. Pre-built integrations include connectors to Adobe, Apple Business Chat, Atlassian Jira, Avaya, Amazon Connect, Cisco, Facebook Messenger, Five9, Google Dialogflow, Genesys, Talkdesk, IBM Watson, Microsoft Dynamics, Microsoft SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, and Zendesk. We offer a novel "Bring Your Own" composable architecture to plug large language models, external bots, messaging channels, and third-party agent desktops to compose differentiated customer experiences.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Strategy
Our business is influenced by a range of factors that are beyond our control and that we have no comparative advantage in forecasting.
Our SaaS business model is subject to certain risks.
We cannot accurately predict subscription renewal rates and the impact these rates may have on our future revenue and operating results.
Our lengthy sales cycles and the difficulty in predicting timing of sales or delays may impair our operating results.
The market for customer engagement software, including generative AI product offerings, is competitive, and our business will be adversely affected if we are unable to successfully compete.
Our failure to maintain, develop, or expand strategic and third-party distribution channels would impede our revenue growth.
Difficulties and delays in customers implementing our products could harm our revenue and margins.
Software errors could be costly and time-consuming for us to correct, and could harm our reputation and impair our ability to sell our solutions.
The terms we agree to in our Service Level Agreements or other contracts may result in increased costs or liabilities, which would in turn affect our results of operations.

If we are unable to increase the profitability of SaaS revenue, if we experience significant customer attrition, or if we are required to delay recognition of revenue, our operating results could be adversely affected.
We depend on broad market acceptance of our applications and of our business model. If our expectations regarding the market for our applications are not met, our business could be seriously harmed.
We may be unable to respond to the rapid technological change and changing customer preferences in digital customer engagement, marketing, and service and this may cause our business to suffer.
If we are unable to hire and retain key personnel, our business and results of operations would be negatively affected.
We may not be able to realize the benefits of offering the limited, free "Innovation in 30 Days" version of our service.
We may not be able to raise additional capital on acceptable terms, if at all, or without dilution to our stockholders, which could limit our ability to grow our business and expand our operations.
Our provision may be insufficient to cover accounts receivable we are unable to collect.

If we acquire companies or technologies, we may not realize the expected business benefits, the acquisitions could prove difficult to integrate, disrupt our business and adversely affect our operations.
We may be subject to legal liability and/or negative publicity for the services provided to consumers through our technology platforms.

Privacy concerns and laws, evolving regulation of cloud computing, AI and other domestic or foreign regulations may limit the use, functionality and adoption of our solutions and adversely affect our business.
paragraphs: The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones facing us. Other events that we do not currently anticipate or that we currently deem immaterial also may affect our results of operations, cash flows and financial condition.
Factors influencing our business include: ● general economic and business conditions; ● currency exchange rate fluctuations;
● the overall demand for enterprise software and services; ● customer acceptance of cloud-based and AI-enabled solutions;
● governmental budgetary constraints or shifts in government spending priorities; and
● general political and regulatory developments.

The global economic climate continues to influence our business. This includes factors such as a general tightening in the credit markets, lower levels of liquidity, increases in the rates of default and bankruptcy, and extreme volatility in credit, equity and fixed income markets. These macroeconomic developments negatively affected, and could continue to negatively affect, our business, operating results or financial condition which, in turn, could adversely affect our stock price. A general weakening of, and related declining corporate confidence in, the global economy or the curtailment in government or corporate spending could cause current or potential customers to reduce their technology budgets or be unable to fund software or services purchases, which could cause customers to delay, decrease or cancel purchases of our products and services or cause customers to not pay us or to delay paying us for previously purchased products and services.

The preparation of these financial statements requires management to make estimates and assumptions that affect the reported amounts of assets and liabilities and the disclosure of contingent assets and liabilities at the date of the financial statements and the reported amounts of revenue and expenses during the reporting period.

We believe that the assumptions and estimates associated with revenue recognition, stock-based compensation, provision for credit losses, the valuation of goodwill, the valuation of deferred tax allowance, and legal contingencies have the greatest potential impact on our consolidated financial statements. We evaluate these estimates on an ongoing basis. Management bases its estimates and judgments on historical experience and on various other factors that are believed to be reasonable under the circumstances, the results of which form the basis for making judgments about the carrying values of assets and liabilities that are not readily apparent from other sources. paragraphs: eGain 以 AI 知識中心解決方案自動化客戶體驗。我們將 SaaS 解決方案銷售給希望透過 AI 合成並提供可信、可消費的答覆以改善客戶體驗同時降低成本的企業。本公司總部設於美國加州 Sunnyvale。我們也在英國和印度運營。

根據 Gartner 研究，大多數客服專員對其桌面工具並不滿意。根據我們超過二十年服務客戶的評估，優秀的客服專員在與客戶互動時，會忽略螢幕上多個視窗和分頁中堆積的資訊。他們專注於與客戶的對話。同時，企業期望專員能記憶並更新日益增長的知識，以應對複雜且不斷擴展的產品組合及重視合規的流程，並在關鍵時刻（客戶正在通話時）情境化地回憶這些知識。此外，這也是對薪資不高、經常更換且全球分散的初階人力的期待。在工作中，客服專員的知識與指導缺口解釋了 Gartner 研究對客服與支援領導者的首選科技建議：投資現代知識管理工具。
在一個銷售標準化但複雜產品給時間有限的客戶的環境中，智慧工具必須越來越自動化自助服務互動，並增強客服協助的客戶體驗。在混合式工作場域中，企業體認到需要投資能以可信答覆引導客服與客戶的工具，確保合規。此外，AI 投資在規模上難以產生價值，因為企業內碎片化知識內容導致的 "垃圾進垃圾出" 問題。解決方案是建立一個中央知識中心，作為一個由 AI 驅動且由專家參與的單一真實來源。
為自動化客戶互動，生成式 AI 需要來自知識中心的可信內容，以確保正確且合規的內容能透過適當的控制提供。知識中心可以透過 AI 以較少的時間和成本建立和維護。這是一種完美的科技起點 - AI 需要可信知識作為輸入，而可信知識可以透過 AI 更容易建立。

聯絡中心在任何企業營運中提供一個極佳的機會，以AI進行自動化。根據Forrester Research的資料，2024年全球有17 百萬聯絡中心專員，其中71%的聯絡中心計畫招募更多人。時間緊迫的客戶在使用複雜產品並面對極端選擇時，會產生頑強的高客戶接觸率。他們需要快速、正確且有保障的協助。在聯絡中心營運中大規模應用AI的商業影響，可能在全球範圍內每年節省數百十億美元，更不用說良好服務的正面影響。
企業持續投資於數位轉型，特別是在客戶體驗方面。為進一步降低成本並提升體驗，企業希望運用AI知識，透過全通路、對話式介面自動化客戶服務。根據McKinsey的資料，全球經濟中客戶營運的總成本為
1.5 兆美元。他們預期企業可透過 AI 減少 35% 的成本。考慮到這些潛在節省，與 AI SaaS 解決方案相關的市場機會，用於客戶體驗（CX）的領域非常龐大。根據 2024 年 Gartner 研究預測，所有未整合現代知識管理系統的虛擬客戶助理與虛擬代理助理專案，將無法達成其體驗改進與運營成本降低的目標。
我們認為客戶服務查詢可歸納為三類：資訊性、交易性與情境性。客戶聯繫可能隨著對話進行涵蓋其中一項或多項這三類別。工具必須以情境為基礎協調客戶聯繫 — 考慮機器與人類的交接 (混合式互動)、通訊渠道切換、多模式互動以及對話暫停與恢復。在這些互動中，客戶越來越希望獲得指導與值得信賴的答案。
eGain 提供一套完整的解決方案，分為三個核心模組 — eGain AI Agent™、eGain AI Knowledge Hub™、以及 eGain Conversation Hub™ — 用以自動化客戶體驗。
eGain AI Agent 幫助企業輕鬆部署企業級的代理解決方案，這些解決方案建立在可信的知識與引導行動之上。我們的 AI Agent 用於客服中心，協助人類客服人員透過主動聆聽客戶對話，並逐步引導客戶完成意圖識別、問題解決與聯絡結案。
eGain AI Knowledge Hub 幫助企業集中知識、政策、程序、情境專業知識與最佳實務，同時提供給客戶、客服人員與現場員工具備引導性、個性化與可信的回應。我們相信，我們的引導知識應用程式可確保所有人類客服人員，不論資歷或專業程度，都能處理客戶聯絡。
eGain Conversation Hub 提供全面且可擴展的數位先導互動管理能力，適用於現代的跨通路桌面環境。人類客服人員透過 AI 知識被主動引導，以提高效率服務客戶，包括聊天、簡訊服務（SMS）、電子郵件、社交媒體、電話、視訊、傳真與書信。

我們的開放且安全的平台 API 使客戶與合作夥伴得以擴展與增強我們的解決方案，並整合企業資產以實現客戶的單一視圖。預建的整合包括與 Adobe、Apple Business Chat、Atlassian Jira、Avaya、Amazon Connect、Cisco、Facebook Messenger、Five9、Google Dialogflow、Genesys、Talkdesk、IBM Watson、Microsoft Dynamics、Microsoft SharePoint、Microsoft Teams、Salesforce、SAP、ServiceNow 以及 Zendesk 的連接器。我們提供一種創新 "Bring Your Own" 可組合架構，用以插入大型語言模型、外部機器人、通訊頻道與第三方客服桌面，以組合差異化的客戶體驗。
我們的解決方案可快速產生價值、輕鬆創新並帶來重大商業影響。具體來說，我們協助企業：

董事長對財務狀況與營運成果之分析，討論了我們的合併財務報表，這些財務報表依照美國的 GAAP 進行編製。這些財務報表的編製需要管理階層做出估計與假設，這些估計與假設會影響財務報表日資產與負債的金額，以及對或有資產與負債的揭露，同時也會影響報告期間內收入與費用的金額。
我們認為與收入認列、股票基於報酬、信用損失提列、商譽評價、遞延稅資產評價以及法律爭議相關的假設與估計，對我們的合併財務報表有最大的潛在影響。我們會持續評估這些估計。管理階層根據歷史經驗及其他被認為在當前情況下合理的因素，做出這些估計與判斷，這些結果成為判斷那些無法從其他來源輕易得知的資產與負債攜帶價值的基礎。實際結果可能因不同的假設或條件而與這些估計不同。
我們的收入包含兩類，包括 SaaS 與專業服務。SaaS 收入包含雲端交付安排、定期授權、內嵌 OEM 特許權使用費以及相關支援。SaaS 收入中有一小部分為我們的遺留收入，與永久授權安排下的授權、維護與支援合約相關，而我們已不再銷售這些合約。專業服務包括諮詢、實作、培訓與管理服務。

headings: 與我們業務及策略相關的風險
我們的業務受許多超出我們控制範圍的因素影響，而我們在預測這些因素方面也沒有相對優勢。
我們的 SaaS 商業模式面臨某些風險。
我們無法準確預測訂閱續約率，以及這些率可能對我們未來營業收入與營運結果的影響。
我們的銷售週期較長，且預測銷售時間或延誤的困難，可能影響我們的營運結果。
客戶互動軟體市場，包括生成式 AI 產品方案，競爭激烈，若我們無法成功競爭，將對我們的業務產生負面影響。
我們若無法維持、發展或擴展策略性與第三方通路渠道，將會阻礙我們的營收成長。
客戶在實施我們產品時遇到困難或延誤，可能對我們的營收與毛利率造成傷害。
軟體錯誤可能對我們而言既昂貴又耗時進行修正，並可能損害我們的聲譽，並影響我們銷售解決方案的能力。
我們在服務水準協議或其他契約中同意的條款，可能會導致成本或義務增加，進而影響我們的營運結果。
若我們無法提高 SaaS 收入的獲利性，若我們遭遇重大客戶流失，或若我們被要求延遲確認收入，則我們的營運結果可能受到不利影響。
我們依賴廣泛市場對我們應用程式及商業模式的接受度。若我們對應用程式市場的預期未達成，則我們的業務可能受到嚴重影響。
我們可能無法因應數位客戶互動、行銷及服務領域中快速的技術變革與變更的客戶偏好，這可能會導致我們的業務受損。
若我們無法聘請並留住關鍵人才，則我們的業務與營運結果將受到負面影響。
我們可能無法實現提供有限免費「30 天創新」版本服務的效益。
我們可能無法在合適的條件下籌措額外資金，或完全無法籌措，或必須對股東股票進行稀釋，這可能會限制我們擴展業務與拓展業務的能力建立。
本公司之提列撥備可能不足以覆蓋無法收回之應收帳款。
若本公司取得公司或技術，可能無法實現預期之營運效益，該併購可能難以整合，幹擾本公司營運，並對本公司營運產生不利影響。
本公司可能因透過科技平台提供服務予消費者而面臨法律責任及/或負面宣傳。
隱私權相關顧慮及法規、雲端運算、人工智慧等領域之規範持續演進，以及其他國內外法規，可能限制本公司解決方案之使用、功能及採用度，並對本公司營運產生不利影響。
paragraphs: 下列所描述的風險與不確定性並非我們唯一面臨的風險。其他我們目前未預期或認為不重要之事件，也可能影響我們的營運成果、現金流及財務狀況。
影響我們業務的因素包括：● 總體經濟與商業條件；● 貨幣兌換率波動；
● 企業軟體與服務的總體需求；● 客戶對基於雲端與人工智能解決方案的接受度；
● 政府預算限制或政府支出優先順序的改變；以及
● 總體政治與法規發展。

全球經濟氣候持續影響我們的業務。這包括因素如信用市場普遍收緊、流動性水準降低、違約與破產率增加，以及信用、股權與固定收益市場極度波動。這些總體經濟發展已對我們的業務、營運成果或財務狀況產生負面影響，並可能持續產生負面影響，進而可能對我們的股票價格產生不利影響。全球經濟若普遍走弱，以及相關企業信心下降，或政府與企業支出減少，可能導致現有或潛在客戶減少其科技預算，或無法負擔軟體或服務的採購，這可能會導致客戶延後、減少或取消我們產品與服務的採購，或導致客戶無法付款或延後付款我們先前採購的產品與服務。
